meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Cross-reviewed new shared article retrieval used by the Enterprise and Support context, with published-only filtering and no private chat tool access.

auth.review_note: Checked owner-only administration, CSRF guards, scoped MCP digest records and revocation, and private guide access across both agent surfaces.

commerce.review_note: Reconciled issued document sequence exports against stored invoice evidence and checked protected MCP sales aggregates against dashboard definitions.

content.review_note: Reviewed published Markdown source, future/draft/symlink filtering and bounded article metadata against blog and customer help documentation.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed public PHP capability service, API endpoint routing, module guard and preservation of MySQL and private JSON session boundaries.

google-tags.review_note: Checked public layout addition is a read-only schema and deferred script with no Google consent or reporting credential changes.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed public knowledge API errors for bounded client input, safe 400/503 responses and no internal exception disclosure.

interface.review_note: Reviewed browser WebMCP tool registration, client-side response checks and public layout schema, without exposing authenticated state.

mail.review_note: Verified editorial page and article preview, scheduling and save paths maintain separation from newsletter and order email dispatch.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed new native read-only article discovery, argument schemas, module disabling and refusal to reveal owner scopes.

media.review_note: Reviewed deployment documentation and confirmed media storage and protected file paths remain independent of public article metadata.

operator-help.review_note: Confirmed owner help remains role-gated while public customer guides are published BlogService entries, not raw admin Markdown.

sales-channels.review_note: Checked public product visibility, published navigation destinations and isolated first-party catalogue and policy discovery.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the new synthetic public Markdown, WebMCP and MCP transport test gates and generated documentation process.
